stops.note: to satisfy a debt, to set free, from ad- (to) and quietus (at rest)
stops.meaning: to set free, to satisfy a claim

stops.note: carried into French legal vocabulary for discharging an obligation or clearing a charge
stops.meaning: to discharge, to clear of a charge

stops.note: settled as the English word for a formal clearing of a criminal charge
stops.meaning: a formal declaration that a defendant is not guilty

current_meaning: a formal declaration that a person is not guilty of a charged offense
